summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized valid/invalid cases, a non-node input test, and a cyclic rdf:rest test. Running the new tests with test_path.py: 41 passed. Not verified: black, isort, and mypy are not installed in the shared venv, so formatting and type-check results (including type-ignore placement) are unconfirmed. Nothing was committed, and no other files were changed.
